source_tests: HumanEval+ (EvalPlus, Liu et al. 2023, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus), HumanEval/64 from https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/humanevalplus
statement: Count the vowels in a word. The vowels are a, e, i, o, u in lower or upper case, and also the letter y, but only when it is the last letter of the word.
